bloques.titulo: The transformation of supplements: accentuative to didative
texto: 1. **El acusativo pasa a sujeto (Nominativo)**: Active: «Der Fuhrparkleiter übergibt **den Schlüssel** (Akkusativ)». In passive: «**Der Schlüssel** (Nominativ) wird übergeben». The passive verb always matches in number with this new subject.

2. **El dativo permanece en dativo**: In German, unlike other languages, the indirect complement never becomes a passive subject: Active: «Der Chef dankt **dem Mitarbeiter** (Dativ)». In passive: «**Dem Mitarbeiter** (Dativ) wird gedankt» (the employee is grateful). You never say «Der Mitarbeiter wird gedankt»!
3. **Con dos complementos**: «Der Fuhrparkleiter übergibt **dem Mitarbeiter** (Dativ) **das Auto** (Akkusativ)» → «**Das Auto** (Sujeto) wird **dem Mitarbeiter** (Dativo) übergeben».

bloques.titulo: Vocabulary: resource delivery in the company

frases.de: Wurde dir der neue Dienstwagen schon übergeben?
frases.es: ¿Ya te fue entregado el nuevo coche de empresa?
frases.en: Did you get the new company car?
analisis: Did the new company car go to you?

frases.de: Ja, der Schlüssel wurde mir heute früh vom Fuhrparkleiter ausgehändigt.
frases.es: Sí, la llave me fue entregada hoy temprano por el jefe de flota.
frases.en: Yeah, the key was delivered to me earlier today by the fleet chief.
analisis: der Schlüssel wurde mir heute früh
The key went to me earlier today.

frases.de: Wunderbar! Wurden den Mitarbeitern auch die neuen Laptops zugewiesen?
frases.es: ¡Maravilloso! ¿Se asignaron a los empleados también los nuevos portátiles?
frases.en: Wonderful! Were new laptops also assigned to employees?
analisis: Did you go to the employees too?

frases.de: Nein, die Laptops werden uns erst nächste Woche geliefert.
frases.es: No, los portátiles se nos entregarán la próxima semana.
frases.en: No, the laptops will be delivered to us next week.

bloques.pregunta: What happens to the indirect in dative complement when passing an active to passive prayer?

opciones.texto: It remains mandatory in the day and never becomes a subject of the passive
opciones.explicacion: In German, only the accusative objects can assume the function of a passive subject.

opciones.texto: It always happens to be the nominee of the phrase
opciones.explicacion: It is a misguided of the English passive («He was given...» does not exist in German).

opciones.texto: It is necessarily transformed into an accusative to agree with the verb
opciones.explicacion: The cases are not arbitrarily exchanged; the matter is protected and invariable.

bloques.pregunta: In the «Dem Kunden wird das Angebot zugeschickt» phrase, what is the grammatical subject?

opciones.explicacion: «Das Angebot» governs the «wird» auxiliary's concordance in 3rd person of the singular.
It is the indirect complement in dative, not the grammatical subject of prayer.
The prayer is strictly personal passive with express subject («das Angebot»).

bloques.frase: Dem Mitarbeiter ___ der Schlüssel zum Dienstwagen ausgehändigt.

opciones.explicacion: The subject in nominee is «der Schlüssel» (singular masculine); «dem Mitarbeiter» remains in dative.
The «der Schlüssel» subject is singular, not plural.
It is time for active Plusquamperfekt with intransitive, non-passive verbs.

bloques.frase: Der neue Dienstwagen wurde ___ Kollegin übergeben.

opciones.explicacion: «übergeben» rules dative for the target person («der Kollegin», feminine dative).
It would be either indicative or nominative feminine.
It would be plural or accusative Dativa masculine.

bloques.pregunta: What action does this phrase describe?
bloques.frase: Den Mitarbeitern wurden gestern die neuen Laptops zugewiesen.

opciones.texto: The employees were assigned the new laptops yesterday.
opciones.explicacion: «die neuen Laptops» is the subject in plural nominative («wurden») and «den Mitarbeitern» is the plural dative.

opciones.texto: The employees delivered their old laptops to the company.
opciones.explicacion: In the phrase the employees receive the equipment, they do not deliver it.

opciones.texto: The company cancelled the purchase of laptops for the technical department.
opciones.explicacion: It describes the actual allocation of the new equipment.

bloques.frase: Dem Mitarbeiter ___ die neuen Laptops heute ausgehändigt.

opciones.explicacion: The nominating subject is «die neuen Laptops» (plural), so the auxiliary should be «wurden».
«wurde» is singular; it would create an error of agreement with the subject in plural.

bloques.traduccion: The key was delivered to me.
bloques.explicacion: Nominal subject + wurde + dative mir + participle at the end.

intro: By transforming an active sentence into passive, the direct (accusative) complement becomes a subject, while the indirect (didative) complement remains intact.
